purpose: Decision on whether int8 activation (W4A8/W8A8) MLP prefill should be built and retained for the Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S gfx1151 campaign.
external_premise: External stack's W4A8 Marlin (int8 tensor cores, sign-bug workaround) paid only at 40-64 concurrent, nothing at batch size 1; PPL cost +2.2% (whole MLP) to +3.7% (all linear). On RDNA3 the int8 rate advantage over BF16 WMMA is unproven, and activation quantization violates arithmetic equality by design.

finding.dense_prefill_path: Dense Q4_K_S MLP prefill (rows > 1 GEMM) dispatches pack8_dual_wmma_prefill_bf16_bf16_out: BF16 WMMA with Q4_K weights, NO activation quantization.
finding.dense_decode_path: Dense pair_silu decode is ALREADY int8-activation (W8A8): gguf_q4_k_quantize_bf16_q8_1 feeds Q8_1x2 dp4a GEMV owners (dense_dual_q8_1x2_split_weight_dp4a serial c1, dense_dual_q8_1x2_rowtile8_dp4a native rows 2-4). The 'perf boost on INT8' is already captured on the memory-bound decode path.
finding.w8a8_prefill_prototype: The only W8A8 prefill prototype (hip_gfx1100/quant/gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill) is a MoE selected-expert diagnostic microbench, not wired into dense dispatch and gfx1100-only.
finding.registered_prefill_variants: Sole registered q8_1 prefill on gfx1151 is selected_mmq_i128_j128_k256_q8_1_ds4_prefill_compact_bf16_bf16_out, MoE-only (gguf_iq3_xxs / gguf_iq4_xs); never the dense linear_pair_silu / gguf_q4_k key.
finding.blocker_to_build: No dense W4A8 prefill kernel and no prefill-scale (rows >> 4) activation quantizer; registration against linear_pair_silu/gguf_q4_k needs a strict unfused fallback; production retention needs strict-teacher mean/tail/max KL + top-1 by category/shape/transition + BF16-relative + task gates on the full multi-prompt suite (activation quant violates arithmetic equality by design).

payoff_assessment.prefill_is_compute_bound: G6 closure prefill 379.40 / 376.55 / 369.75 tok/s at 512/1K/4K (beats frozen llama HIP 352.43 / 364.44 / 367.99). Weight-read at ~12 GB/s << ~256 GB/s bandwidth, so prefill is compute-bound (Q4_K dequant + WMMA), not memory-bound -> a W8A8 prefill could in principle raise prefill throughput.
payoff_assessment.decode_is_the_bottleneck: Topline bottleneck is decode ~13 tok/s (memory-bound at ~81% of ~256 GB/s bandwidth); decode is already W8A8, so an int8 prefill cannot lift the gating metric.
payoff_assessment.concurrency_regime_out_of_scope: External W4A8 paid only at 40-64 concurrent; this campaign is c=1-8 on a unified-memory part with a different concurrency profile.
payoff_assessment.quality_risk: Activation quantization quality risk (external +2.2-3.7% PPL) must clear our stricter KL/top-1 production-profile gate to be retained.

decision: Not pursued. No dispatchable dense int8-activation prefill path exists for the Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S gfx1151 MLP; building one is a full new-kernel unit (prefill-scale activation quantizer + Q4_K->Q8_1/dp4a dual gate/up prefill + strict fallback + full profile gate) targeting a phase (prefill) that is not this campaign's bottleneck (decode is, and it is already int8-activation). Revisit only under a prefill-throughput/concurrency target (>=40 concurrent) where int8 GEMM rate and the external PPL floor become the governing economics.

evidence.decode_w8a8_dispatch: hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1151/__init__.py GGUF_DENSE_PAIR_SILU_DECODE_POLICIES / NATIVE_DECODE_POLICIES; hipengine/runtime/gguf_linear.py launch_gguf_linear_pair_silu (gguf_q4_k_quantize_bf16_q8_1x2 before dense_dual_q8_1x2_*_dp4a GEMV)
evidence.no_q8_1_dense_prefill_registration: hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1151/__init__.py registered linear_pair_silu variants list (13 variants; only pack8_dual_wmma_prefill_bf16_bf16_out is a prefill; q8_1x2 variants are decode GEMV)
evidence.w8a8_prototype_not_wired: hipengine/kernels/hip_gfx1100/quant/gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill.py docstring: diagnostic microbench, not wired into model dispatch
